story.title: The faded rainbow
story.intro: Oh no! The rainbow over Rainbow Valley has lost its colours. {hero} the unicorn and {sidekick} the little cloud need your help. Every word you spell paints a colour back!
story.ending: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple! The rainbow shines over Rainbow Valley again. {hero} and {sidekick} say thank you for all those wonderful words!

soundSort.speaker: hero
soundSort.title: The paint pots
soundSort.intro: We've got a paint pot for each way to spell this week's sound. Help me put every word in the right pot!
soundSort.prompt: Which paint pot does this word go in?

pickPatch.speaker: sidekick
pickPatch.title: The rainbow bridge
pickPatch.intro: The stepping stones on the rainbow bridge have letters missing! Listen to the word, then pick the missing letters so we can cross.
pickPatch.prompt: Listen, then pick the missing letters!

lookRight.speaker: hero
lookRight.title: The cupcake stall
lookRight.intro: Mmm, cupcakes! But the baker has written her sign three different ways. Listen to the word and find the one that's spelt right.

spellIt.speaker: sidekick
spellIt.title: Writing in the sky
spellIt.intro: Let's write the words in the sky with my fluffy cloud, before the wind blows them away! Look at the word, then spell it with the letters.
spellIt.prompt: Look at the word and say it. Tap the button when you're ready!

writeIt.speaker: hero
writeIt.title: Sparkle writing
writeIt.intro: My horn can write with sparkles! Look at the word, then write it with your finger, one letter in each box, just like on paper.
writeIt.prompt: Look at the word and say it. Tap the button when you're ready to write it!

tricky.speaker: hero
tricky.title: The crystal cave
tricky.intro: The tricky words are hiding in the crystal cave! They don't follow the rules, so we just have to remember them.
tricky.prompt: This is a tricky word. Look really carefully!

trickyCatch.speaker: sidekick
trickyCatch.title: Waterfall bubbles
trickyCatch.intro: Look, the tricky words are floating up from the waterfall in rainbow bubbles! Listen, then catch the bubble that's spelt right before it floats away.
trickyCatch.prompt: Listen, then catch the bubble that's spelt right!
